main_text.p: cibus & conuersionibus, velut in medio mari, eoq; horribiliter commoto & ç[?]ftu-ante, conseruatum esse, ad consolationem nostram Propheta, enumerationem magnificorū Dei operum hac coronide absoluens, testatur.
Illustrabitur autem sententia, si quis perpendet,

p.i: Imago hostium Ecclesiae illustratur hisce dictis.

main_text.p: Isa.57.20.Impij autem sunt velut mare impulsum: nam quiescere non potest, propelluntq; aquae eius caenum aclutu.
21.Non est pax (dicit Deus) impijs. Quis igitur intelligens miretur adeo esse inquietos, polypragmonicos, & in Sisy-phio suo saxo volvendo assiduos homi-nes impios?
Psalmo 46.2.Non timebimus cum movebitur terra: & concident montes in medio mari.
3. Et personent ac turbentur aquae eius, & concutiantur montes ab eius procellis.
Psal.124.4. de persecutionibus diuini-tus repressis dicitur: Nisi Iehouah nobis adfu[?]

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "ç[?]ftu" at the line end before "ante" (probably a contraction for "constante"; the hyphen is printed). The last line is cut off at the foot of the scan, so "adfu[?]" is incomplete. The reading "Sisy" is inferred from the printed "Sify". Long s has been normalised throughout. The Latin u/v has been corrected to v where consonant. No suspected printing errors beyond the forms kept as printed (e.g. "21.Non", "Isa.57.20.Impij").
